modifications: Append only the selected female body and two eyes; no other asset collection, programs, rig or materials.
Preserve raw mesh vertices/topology, UVs and all Multires sculpt details.
Apply one shared uniform height/unit scale and translation to the parent hierarchy; no shape morph or individual eye transform.
Assign own neutral clay and existing own review camera/light/world for geometry comparison.
Remove unused append library identifiers after proving no linked data. Saved model has no external libraries/texts/images/rigs/actions.

open: Open the .blend directly in Blender. It is standalone and opens with the full-head review camera. Original third-party authoring data remains editable.
rebuild: Run build-female-next-r0028-cc0-foundation.py with Blender 5.2.2, --disable-autoexec, four threads. Requires the pinned r23 source and locally verified original v1.4.1 library at the recorded path. Then run verify-female-next-r0028-cc0-foundation.py. No add-on or other platform required.
